name: Lunge on the Carriage

load.note: A single blue makes the return a real hamstring and balance challenge.

summary: Standing up on the reformer: front foot on the platform, back foot on the carriage against the shoulder rest. The back leg slides the carriage away into a lunge and draws it home.
steps: Step onto the platform with one foot; place the other foot on the carriage against the shoulder rest.
Hands on the footbar to start, standing tall with both knees soft.
Breathe in to slide the carriage back, bending the front knee into a lunge.
Breathe out to pull the carriage home with the front leg and inner thighs.

layers.title: Hands free
layers.text: Hands on hips or arms forward.

layers.title: Add arms
layers.text: Weights, or a twist over the front leg.

layers.title: Back knee bends
layers.text: Lower the back knee towards the carriage like a split squat.

cautions.note: Small range, hands on the bar.
Short range, both hands on the bar.

cues:
Front knee stays over the ankle, tracking the middle toes.
Hips stay square to the footbar.
Come up by pressing the front heel down, not by yanking the carriage.
Tall spine; ribs over hips.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Go back to the lunge with one foot on the floor
